result:
Each query is written from the page alone and none has been run. I made a few guesses that the page doesn't settle:
- `at` on a null `profile` might fail, so S6 reads it with `coalesce {}` first.
- `groupBy` is assumed to accept a key quote such as `~/assignee`.
- `entries` keys are assumed to be keywords, so I convert them with `keyword`.
- `flat` is assumed to splice sets as well as vectors (S9).
- S14 has a tie at 200 days between `cache1` and `api1`. I rely on `sort` being stable and did not add a tiebreak.

S1: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | filter ~(/labels * lower | contains "bug") | count
S2: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | filter ~(/assignee | ne null) | groupBy ~/assignee * count
S3: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | sort ~([(at :priority | coalesce 0 | desc) /id]) | take 3 * /id
S4: [/dependencies /devDependencies] * entries | flat | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") * (/0 | keyword) | distinct | sort
S5: * {:c /customer :t (/items * (mulOf /qty /price) | sum)} | groupBy ~/c * (* /t | sum) | entries * {:customer (/0 | keyword) :total (/1 | round 2)} | sort ~(/total | desc) | take 2
S6: /data/users | filter ~(at :profile | coalesce {} | at :city | coalesce "" | lower | eq "berlin") * (/email | lower) | sort
S7: lines | filter ~(count | gt 0) * split " " | filter ~(/1 | upper | eq "ERROR") | groupBy ~/2 * count
S8: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(count | gt 0) * split "," | filter ~(/2 | ne "") | groupBy ~(/1 | lower) * (* (/2 | parseJson) | avg | round 1)
S9: filter ~(/published | eq true) * (at :tags | coalesce [] * lower | distinct) | flat | groupBy ~(/) * count | entries * {:tag (/0 | keyword) :count /1} | sort ~([(/count | desc) /tag]) | take 3
S10: /services | filter ~(at :enabled | eq true) * (at :port)
S11: filter ~(at :stock | coalesce 0 | gt 0) * (/category | lower) | distinct | sort
S12: "The cat and the Hat and THE bat sat on a mat with the cat" | split " " * lower | groupBy ~(/) * count | entries * {:word (/0 | keyword) :count /1} | sort ~([(/count | desc) /word]) | take 3
S13: groupBy ~/user | entries * {:user (/0 | keyword) :count (/1 | count) :first (/1 * /ts | sort | first)} | sort ~/user
S14: lines | filter ~(count | gt 0) | filter ~(startsWith "#" | not) * split "|" | filter ~(/1 | lower | startsWith "eu-") | filter ~(/2 | ne "down") | sort ~(/3 | parseJson | desc) * /0 | join ","
